positioning.title: The rest of Friuli Venezia Giulia, read properly.
positioning.body: FriuliVillas exists to apply to the rest of the region the working culture built in Trieste — and to read the territory not only as a property market, but as a system of ownership: buying, holding, putting to income, selling, reallocating.
positioning.routingNote: Including when there is more than one property, or when the real question is not the single asset but the next move.

videoBreak.alt: Interiors photographed to convey how a house is lived in, not merely how it is built.

featured.empty: We are refreshing the showcase. Tell us what you are after and we will let you know as soon as something suitable comes in.

sellerValue.title: A sale done well takes weight off, it does not add any.
sellerValue.subtitle: What changes is not the name over the door: it is how the property is read, and how it is explained to whoever will buy it.

fast.title: Reading before pricing
fast.text: Before putting a number on it we look at the property, the paperwork and the market it actually sits in. A well-chosen price is half the sale; a wrong one stalls it for months.

zeroFee.title: Terms in the open
zeroFee.text: Duration, exclusivity and costs are discussed at the start and put in writing. Nothing appears for the first time at completion.

simpleMandate.title: Discretion where it matters
simpleMandate.text: Not every property belongs on a portal. Where discretion counts, the sale runs through a selected circle of contacts rather than a shop window.

marketing.title: Material done properly
marketing.text: Photography, video, drone and 3D tours. Not for show: because buyers from outside the region decide on what they can understand from a distance.

investorTeaser.title: Buying in Trieste to put it to work.
investorTeaser.body: We hold already-let units in central, recently renovated buildings. Some are never advertised: we share them in person. Tell us your budget and target return and we'll come back with options ranked by ROI.

groupRouting.title: Six brands, one structure.
groupRouting.body: FriuliVillas is part of the TriesteVillas ecosystem. Each brand covers its own segment, so an enquiry reaches the people equipped to handle it.

valuationCta.title: What is your property really worth?
valuationCta.body: We believe in what we do: start a conversation and you will see that selling with us is different. No obligation, no pressure.

hero.title: Selling in Friuli Venezia Giulia with more strategy and less friction.
hero.intro: A serious reading of the property, material done properly, and a legible path from first contact to completion — with the TriesteVillas group behind it.
hero.videoAlt: Bright interiors opening onto the outside.

sell.blocksTitle: What changes when you sell with us

velocita.title: No dead time
velocita.text: We reply quickly and move as soon as the paperwork allows. Slowness in a sale is not prudence: it is time in which the property ages in the window and loses negotiating strength.

mandatoSemplice.title: Terms in the open
mandatoSemplice.text: Duration, exclusivity, costs and what is included are discussed at the start and put in writing. Nothing surfaces at completion, and nothing renews itself while you are looking elsewhere.

checkup.title: Pre-sale check-up
checkup.text: Before rushing online we check whether the house is genuinely ready: compliance, paperwork, EPC, land registry. Finding a problem mid-negotiation costs far more than finding it first.

materiale.title: Photography, video, drone, 3D tours
materiale.text: The material is not there for show: it is there so someone who cannot visit tomorrow can still understand the property. Across the region, where many buyers come from abroad, it often decides whether the visit happens at all.

liftingPreVendita.title: Pre-sale lift
liftingPreVendita.text: Putting a house online exactly as it stands is not always the right move: sometimes a few targeted interventions make the photographs tell a different story. We will say when it is worth it and when it is not.

ownerJourney.title: Concentrated viewings
ownerJourney.text: Where possible we gather viewings into a few agreed windows rather than scattering them. For someone living in the property — or living far from it — that is the difference between a manageable sale and months of a permanently tidy house.

primaVendiPoiCerca.title: Sell well first, then look
primaVendiPoiCerca.text: Falling for the new house before selling the old one is the most common way to undersell the old one. If the next move is already in mind, let us put it in the right order.

affittaMentreVendi.title: Let it while you sell
affittaMentreVendi.text: If it is not the right moment to sell, the property can earn in the meantime rather than sit idle. TriesteAffitti takes over in that case — it is part of the group, so we are not sending you elsewhere.

acquirentiEsteri.title: Specialists in foreign buyers
acquirentiEsteri.text: Many of our buyers are not Italian: Austrians, Germans, and people looking for a second home in a region that has both sea and mountains. We make everything legible in English and German, from the listing to the paperwork.
acquirentiEsteri.quote: Friuli Venezia Giulia should not just be shown. It should be explained.

houseTour.title: Guided house tours
houseTour.text: For someone arriving from abroad the point is not only to see houses: it is to understand the place. We build viewing days that make sense, allowing for distances — which matter far more here than in a city.

venditaRiservata.title: Confidential sale
venditaRiservata.text: Selling does not necessarily mean publishing on portals. Where discretion counts, the property is put to a selected circle of contacts without ever appearing in a shop window.

forzaDelGruppo.title: The strength of the group
forzaDelGruppo.text: With FriuliVillas you are not dealing with a single name. If the property is luxury, if it is in Trieste, if it is in Lignano, or if letting is the better route, someone inside the group already handles that every day.

process.title: From the first call to completion, in the open.
process.subtitle: An orderly, legible path, designed to take friction away from the seller.

call.title: Introductory call
call.text: You tell us about the property and the situation. We work out straight away whether and how we can help — and if we cannot, we say so.

docs.title: Paperwork and viewing
docs.text: You send the documentation and we come to see the property. From there comes a reasoned valuation, not a number thrown out.

online.title: Material and publication
online.text: Photography, video, drone and 3D tours. Then publication on the channels that suit that kind of property — which are not always the same ones.

visits.title: Managed viewings
visits.text: Viewings gathered into agreed windows, with a serious filter upstream: whoever arrives has already seen everything that could be seen from a distance.

deal.title: Negotiation and completion
deal.text: We handle offers and negotiation through to completion, keeping the thread with the notary and the other side. You take home the result.

closing.title: An honest valuation, with no obligation.
closing.text: We believe in what we do: start a conversation and you will see that selling with us is different. No obligation, no pressure.

property.taxDisclaimer: Indicative estimates on the cadastral (price-value) basis, not binding. Always confirm with your notary or accountant.
property.taxAiDisclaimer: Automatically calculated (AI) estimates: as such, they may contain calculation or transcription errors. The only reliable source is an in-person discussion with the owner, after studying the specific situation.
property.taxCondoInfoBody: Indicative annual figure based on the reported ordinary charges. Extraordinary works and metered consumption (e.g. heating) are excluded. The official figure is the administrator's statement.
property.taxIliaInfoBody: AI-generated estimate, computed as a second home in Trieste on the cadastral income (rate 10.6‰). It does not replace the official calculation: it depends on the cadastral category, ownership share and months of possession, and any reliefs. A non-luxury main residence is exempt. Always check with your accountant or the Trieste Council tax office.
property.taxTariInfoBody: Rough AI estimate based on the City of Trieste 2026 household waste-tax rates. TARI is charged on the net floor area (calpestabile): we estimate it at about 80% of the commercial sqm. You can change the number of occupants below (default 2). The actual amount depends on the real area, the occupants and any reductions, and does not replace the bill issued by ESATTO S.p.A.
property.taxEstimateFootnote: Annual costs are indicative AI estimates and do not replace an official check.

group.title: Separate brands, a single direction.
group.intro: A property ecosystem built around specialisation. Each brand covers its own segment, with the same working culture behind it.

ecosystem.title: A system built properly.
ecosystem.body: Not every property is sold, let or managed the same way. A fine villa, a small flat bought for income and a holiday house by the sea call for different language, different channels and different contacts. That is why the group is made of separate brands rather than one name claiming to do everything.
ecosystem.tagline: Not a shared logo, not a repeated name. The same working culture, applied where it belongs.

group.brandsSubtitle: A single structure covering every property need between Trieste and the rest of Friuli Venezia Giulia.

story.eyebrow: What we were, what we are
story.title: From hospitality to a group.
story.intro: FriuliVillas was born inside a group that knew this territory long before it dealt in sales.

start.title: Beginnings in fine hospitality
start.text: The group began managing villas and apartments for a demanding, largely foreign clientele. That is where the habit comes from: treating a property as something to be explained, not merely shown.

pivot.title: The pivot to sales
pivot.text: Relationships and market knowledge turned into a brokerage practice: first in Trieste, where the method was built and tested.

today.title: One group, clear roles
today.text: FriuliVillas is the territorial extension of that know-how to the rest of the region: Grado, Udine, Tarvisio, Lignano, Sappada. Same direction, different perimeter.

specialised.title: Specialised, not generalist
specialised.text: Each brand has its focus, its language and its strategy. Nobody ends up in the wrong place for our convenience.

local.title: Local and independent
local.text: We know the North-East because we work and live here. No distant head office deciding from a map.

clarity.title: Clarity first
clarity.text: Paperwork in order, realistic prices, terms in the open. No surprises left to ripen until completion.

journey.title: From first contact to completion
journey.text: We stay with you at every stage, on a path designed to remove friction rather than add it.

group.ctaTitle: Come in through the right door.
group.ctaText: Every property segment needs different tools. Our job is to send you to the brand that handles your case every day.
